listings.thesis: Advanced PCB/interconnect leverage; tight-supply, AI-adjacent, underfollowed, 2026-catalyst, central-node.
listings.revisionNote: On a residual-alpha lens, another +6.45% pop to +287.9% YTD on already-public May revenue news and a minor NT$1.05B equipment buy is rerating chase, not new mispricing; the crowding penalty yesterday's verdict flagged got worse, not better.

priorCase.rankRationale: On the residual-alpha-vs-passives lens, no new fundamental evidence since June 9 (May revenue was already public on June 5). +318% YTD at $21B cap with another news-free pop is rerating chase, not fresh mispricing; crowding penalty deepens slightly, extending the June 9 down call.
